answer.reason: Two events belong to Syria in these verses: the spread of Jesus' fame through it and Paul's visit to confirm its churches.

clauses.english: was reached throughout by the fame of Jesus, who healed the sick brought to him
clauses.quote: his fame went throughout all Syria

clauses.english: was travelled through by Paul, who confirmed its churches
clauses.quote: he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches

doubts: Cyrenius as governor of Syria (LUK 2:2) is only a dating note, so it was left out.
Paul's other sailings into Syria (ACT 18:18, ACT 20:3, ACT 21:3) and GAL 1:21 are mere stages of journeys, so they were left out.
